patterns.note: Centralized content with a vast amount of negative space, focusing the viewer on the singular loading element.
A single, small, dark grey numeric text element, '999%', is positioned centrally to indicate progress or a loading state.
Predominantly white background combined with a very subtle, soft light grey used for the central elliptical element, creating a minimalist and clean aesthetic.
The page comprises a single, undifferentiated section, with no headers, footers, or navigational elements, entirely dedicated to the loading indicator.
An implied soft, ambient motion for the central elliptical glow, suggesting a subtle pulsing or breathing effect characteristic of a waiting state, though not explicitly shown in a static image.

technique_notes: To create the central soft glow, an elliptical element is positioned in the viewport's center. This element is given a very light grey background color and a significant blur radius (e.g., using a filter or box-shadow with spread) to create a halo-like diffusion. The opacity might also be slightly reduced to blend seamlessly with the white background.

A small, dark grey text element (e.g., '999%') is absolutely positioned to be horizontally and vertically centered within or directly beneath the blurred elliptical element, ensuring it remains legible against the subtle background.
